description:
This notice is a Sources Sought only notice.

The Government has a requirement for eight (8) Bleacher Seating Systems for Joint Base San Antonio (JBSA) Camp Bullis and Lackland, (San Antonio) TX. Complete and return the attached Request for Information (RFI). See Statement of Work (SOW) (Attachment 1) and Salient Characteristics (Attachment 2) for additional details. The point of contacts (POCs) are: 2nd Lt. Jalisa Brown,  jalisa.brown.1@us.af.mil and Belinda Tindal, belinda.tindal.1@us.af.mil.
